h:
环顾四周后，我发现您可以下载的大多数工作流程对于初次用户来说都非常复杂，甚至是人们所说的简单的工作流程，所以我做了这个。

只是一个基本的工作流程，帮助那些不了解如何制定自己的工作流程或不了解如何使用更复杂的工作流程的人开始。

只需安装 comfyui 管理器并安装缺少的自定义节点即可。

该模型目前仅支持 lora 的 txt2img，但稍后可能会更新以支持 img2img

您可以通过 comfyui 管理器的安装模型选项卡下载您选择的图像升级器和 gfpgan1.4

与 1.2 相比，V1.3 具有更多可定制的面部恢复功能，对于 comfyui 的全新用户来说使用起来更加复杂，但与大多数其他具有面部恢复功能的可用工作流程相比，它的设置仍然要简单得多，面部恢复的大多数设置都可以像大多数设置一样使用，如果您觉得它做得不够，您可以调整您希望它运行面部恢复的步骤和周期数。

https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Manager

o.en:
after looking around i found that most workflows you can download are extremely complicated for a first time user, even the ones that people call simple so i made this.

just a basic workflow to get people started who dont understand how to make their own workflow or dont understand how to use a more complex one.

Just install comfyui manager and install missing custom nodes and you are good to go.

This model is currently txt2img only with lora support, however may be updated later to also support img2img

you can download a image upscaler of your choice and gfpgan1.4 through the install models tab of comfyui manager

V1.3 has a more customizable face restoration feature making it more complicated to use for someone who is a brand new user of comfyui compared to 1.2 but is still a far simpler setup than most other available workflows with face restoration features, most of the settings for face restore will be fine to use as is for most setups, you can just adjust the amount of steps and cycles you want it to run of the face restore if you feel it isnt doing enough.

https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Manager
